content.short: Scallop is the primary peer-to-peer money market on Sui, offering high-yield lending and professional DeFi tools.
content.description:
Scallop is the leading decentralized money market and liquidity protocol built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide a professional-grade borrowing and lending experience. As the first DeFi project officially funded by a grant from the Sui Foundation, the platform focuses on institutional-grade security and maximum capital efficiency. Users can supply various digital assets to earn interest or borrow against them with sub-second finality, leveraging the high throughput and safety of Sui's Move programming language.

Powered by the $SCA token, the protocol features a robust governance model and innovative tools such as the Scallop SDK for building complex programmable transaction blocks. Scallop serves as a vital liquidity hub for the Sui ecosystem, providing the essential infrastructure needed for project bootstrapping and sophisticated on-chain asset management. Through its commitment to transparency and community-driven growth, Scallop is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with unparalleled ease and security.
content.meta: Scallop offers decentralized lending, borrowing, and professional-grade DeFi tools on the Sui blockchain.
